title: The Last Toast
intro: You are about to watch a short film, shot by shot. It takes place during a dinner at an old mansion.
style: Cinematic film still, 35mm film, dim candlelight, moody shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic, high detail.

characters.host: an elegant older woman with silver hair in a black dress
characters.guest: a young man with brown hair in a white shirt

s1_establish.prompt: Wide shot of a candlelit dining room in an old mansion, a long table with silverware. {host} and {guest} sit across from each other, smiling and talking.
s1_establish.description: Wide shot of a candlelit dining room. A silver-haired woman in black and a young man in a white shirt sit at the table, smiling and talking.

s2_reveal.prompt: Close-up in a dim kitchen: {host}'s hand secretly pours clear liquid from a small glass vial with a skull and crossbones label into a crystal glass of red wine.
s2_reveal.description: Close-up in the kitchen: the host secretly pours liquid from a small vial with a skull label into a glass of wine.

s2_filler.prompt: Close-up in a dim kitchen: {host}'s hand pours red wine from a dark glass bottle into a crystal glass.
s2_filler.description: Close-up in the kitchen: the host pours red wine from a bottle into a glass.

s3_serve.prompt: Medium shot of {host} walking into the candlelit dining room and placing a crystal glass of red wine in front of {guest}, smiling warmly.
s3_serve.description: Medium shot: the host places the glass of wine in front of the young man, smiling warmly.

s4_toast.prompt: Medium shot of {guest} raising a crystal glass of red wine for a toast, smiling and talking, candlelight on his face.
s4_toast.description: Medium shot: the young man raises the glass for a toast, smiling.

s5_drink.prompt: Extreme close-up of {guest}'s lips touching the rim of a crystal glass and slowly drinking red wine.
s5_drink.description: Extreme close-up: the young man slowly drinks the wine.

s6_collapse.prompt: Medium shot of {guest} suddenly clutching his throat, gasping, and collapsing onto the dinner table, knocking over candles and glasses.
s6_collapse.description: The young man suddenly clutches his throat and collapses onto the table.

questions.text: Based only on what you have seen so far, how do you think this dinner will end?

options.calm: The dinner ends pleasantly and nothing bad happens.
options.escape: Something sinister is attempted, but the young man ends up unharmed.

probe_facts.question: Is someone pouring liquid from a small vial labeled as poison in this shot?
Is a person collapsing or choking in this shot?
